CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS nat130;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nat130.social_identity (
    id               bigint      GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    platform         text        NOT NULL,
    social_id        text        NOT NULL,
    person_key       text        GENERATED ALWAYS AS (platform || ':' || social_id) STORED,
    source_client    text        NOT NULL,
    display_name     text,
    email            text,
    sms_phone        text,
    zoho_lead_id     text,
    zoho_contact_id  text,
    touches          integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    reactivated      boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    first_seen_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_seen_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_external_id text,
    last_post_id     text,
    last_message     text,
    consent_version  text,
    updated_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT social_identity_person_uniq UNIQUE (platform, social_id),
    CONSTRAINT social_identity_platform_chk CHECK (platform IN ('instagram', 'facebook'))
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS social_identity_lead_idx
    ON nat130.social_identity (zoho_lead_id) WHERE zoho_lead_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS social_identity_email_idx
    ON nat130.social_identity (lower(email)) WHERE email IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS social_identity_seen_idx
    ON nat130.social_identity (last_seen_at DESC);
